subject: Renewal risk: Vanguard AI — stabilization package / exec approval request
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@vanguardai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal risk: Vanguard AI — stabilization package / exec approval request

Samir — thanks for the candid call earlier. I wanted to document where we are and align the team internally.

Recap: Vanguard's contract (annual, committed capacity for inference) comes up 11/30. Usage is down ~38% vs. last year and they've flagged budget cuts; legal is pushing for a hard pause unless we find a path that reduces near-term spend and lowers risk for them. They asked for an amended first-year price that materially reduces MRR and an SLA uplift (99.95 add-on) for enterprise support.

What I'm proposing as a short-term "stabilization package" to keep them on the platform (the goal is to buy 12 months runway and reopen expansion in H2 next year):
- One-time onboarding credit equal to 15% of FY1 committed spend applied as pro-rata credits over Q1 (addresses immediate cash concerns).
- Year-1 list discount of 22% on core inference units (tiered pricing preserved).
- SLA add-on to 99.95 for the first 12 months (trial overlay) with penalty caps limited to credits only (no cash refunds).
- Option to reset the annual term to a 9-month bridge (term-reset) with automatic renewal unless they give 60-day notice.

I've attached an updated financial calc and an offer PDF that lays this out. Need approval from Deal Desk / Finance and an exec sign-off for the discount + term-reset. Can Ben/Marissa confirm if this fits within tolerances? If not, I'll route to Vivek/Karthik for exception.

Attachments: Vanguard_Renewal_Calc.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-stabilization-offer-v2.pdf (pdf)

— Lukas

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal risk: Vanguard AI — stabilization package / exec approval request

+1 to Lukas' framing. Quick notes from Sales perspective:
- Customer is strategic (healthcare vertical partner) — retention has halo effects for two pipeline deals.
- They are price sensitive this quarter but product engagement shows continued usage of embeddings and reranking (higher margin).

Concession ask I'd be comfortable taking to Deal Desk: 20% list discount year-1 + 12% one-time credit (instead of 15%) if Finance signs off. SLA add-on is reasonable as a conditional concession (we should limit penalty exposure). The term-reset to 9 months is atypical but could be acceptable as a temporary bridge if legal signs off on automatic renewal language.

If we need exec approval, recommend we ask for up to: 22% discount + 15% credit + SLA overlay (as Lukas proposed) — conditioned on: signed MAP (mutual action plan) within 7 days and purchase order/commitment to billing start by 11/01.

Ben

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal risk: Vanguard AI — stabilization package / exec approval request

Thanks — finance constraints below. We can absorb a one-time credit up to 12% of ARR as true credit (P&L impact this Q) without board notification; anything above 12% needs FP&A sign-off. For discounts, Deal Desk can approve up to 15% on list for renewal deals in this segment; beyond that requires Finance + Head of Sales (Vivek) approval.

SLA overlay: we will accept an SLA uplift with a credit-only liability cap (not to exceed 3 months of spend) and insurance of capped incidents in the contract. Legal should draft a narrow SLO amendment.

If the team wants to chase the full package Lukas suggested (22% + 15% credit), you will need Vivek and Karthik to approve an exception. Please include a short rationale (strategic partner, pipeline influence, churn risk) and a proposed termination clause for the 9-month reset so Legal can estimate risk.

Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal risk: Vanguard AI — stabilization package / exec approval request

Vivek — forwarding the thread with proposed concessions. My read: this is within the set of strategic exceptions we approve with exec sign-off. Two guardrails I'd add if we approve:
1) Limit the discount to a single-year term and require re-evaluation before any future renewals.
2) Add a performance clause that allows Redwood to revert pricing if usage rebounds beyond a 20% increase vs our model (protects upside).

If OK with you, please approve the following exception bundle: 22% list discount (12 months), 15% one-time credit applied across Q1 invoices, SLA overlay to 99.95 with credit-only liability (cap = 3 months spend), and a temporary 9-month term-reset with auto-renewal. Approval contingent on MAP signed within 7 days and DocuSign by 10/28.

Karthik

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal risk: Vanguard AI — stabilization package / exec approval request

Approved with conditions — I sign off on the exception bundle as Karthik described. Conditions:
- Consolidate the concessions into a single "Stabilization Addendum" that includes (a) defined MAP milestones, (b) clear measurement windows for SLA, and (c) an automatic price reversion clause if usage exceeds thresholds.
- Legal to limit contractual liability to credit-only remedies and add explicit fraud/abuse carve-outs.
- Sales to secure a PO and signed MAP by 2027-10-28. If either fails, concessions expire and standard renewal terms apply.

Ben/Lukas: please route the finalized addendum to Elena Morris at Vanguard (contracts@vanguardai.com) for signature and copy me on the DocuSign link. Finance will record the credit as a one-time Q4 impact; Marissa, please adjust FP&A forecasts accordingly.

Vivek
